stepping-stones.label: Stepping Stones
stepping-stones.pivot: ground origin at the middle of the stone row
stepping-stones.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
stepping-stones.notes: Three flat grey stones in a gravel bed, with moss on the back rim. The stones are walkable, so no blocking footprint is proposed.

rowboat-upturned.label: Rowboat Upturned
rowboat-upturned.pivot: ground origin at the hull centre
rowboat-upturned.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
rowboat-upturned.notes: An upturned hull with a dark keel, plank strakes in two tones, and an oar lying along each flank. The oars and blades overhang the proposed hull footprint.

fallen-log.label: Fallen Log
fallen-log.pivot: ground origin at the centre of the log
fallen-log.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
fallen-log.notes: A round trunk with bark, a pale cut end at +X and moss on top. The proposed footprint is the trunk itself, which a walker would plausibly be blocked by.

mushroom-cluster.label: Mushroom Cluster
mushroom-cluster.pivot: ground origin at the centre of the stump
mushroom-cluster.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
mushroom-cluster.notes: Six cream and violet mushrooms on a short cut stump, 0.3 m tall. The clump is small and walkable around, so no footprint is proposed.

market-stall.label: Market Stall
market-stall.pivot: ground origin at the centre of the stall body
market-stall.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
market-stall.notes: A plank counter with corner posts, a back board and a violet and cream striped canopy, with baskets and apples on the counter. The proposed footprint is the stall body, and the canopy overhangs it.

hanging-sign.label: Hanging Sign
hanging-sign.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
hanging-sign.notes: A timber post with an iron arm and a violet-rimmed board hung in front. The proposed footprint is the post only, since the arm and board overhang it; set it to null if the post should not block.
